item.title: Two Salem Missouri Residents Seriously Injured in Crash Near Seymour
item.description: Two Salem Missouri residents were seriously injured in a crash on U.S. 60 two miles East of Seymour at Star Road Wednesday. The accident happened when a 49-year-old Salem woman failed to yield and pulled her 2015 Chevrolet Malibu into the path of a 2015 Lincoln MKZ driven by a 55-year-old Granby Missouri woman.
